text: I just have a question. Since the certification works well on EvolutionX, is it possible to implement the same thing on DerpFest?

author: Masterdex
text: Right. In A16, you could actually achieve "strong integrity" just by using a valid key; later on, we had to start using modules because the internal integrity mechanism stopped working. Currently, I’m able to get "strong integrity" in Evox, but only by using an external key—the internal one seems to have been revoked. I haven’t managed to achieve "strong integrity" anywhere else, only in Evox. Just to clarify, when I say "strong integrity," I’m not just referring to the three green checkmarks in the Play Integrity Checker—I mean that I’m actually able to make payments using the digital wallet’s "tap-to-pay" feature.

author: Christoph 🇮🇱
text:
DerpFest builds will not get support from me for MEETS_STRONG_INTEGRITY.

Why: my attempts to make STRONG available on DerpFest left my Pixel 11 Pro XL unbootable. I'm not shipping something that can do that to your phone, so DerpFest stays without it.

What this means • DerpFest won't pass STRONG, and requests or bug reports about STRONG on DerpFest will be closed. 

• Please don't try to force it on DerpFest yourself: the same attempts are what broke booting here. 

• Everything else in DerpFest is unaffected.

Need STRONG? The Evolution X builds for the Pixel 11 series support it today: 

kodiak/grizzly https://xdaforums.com/t/4804712/ · cubs https://xdaforums.com/t/4804723/ · yogi https://xdaforums.com/t/4804826/
Questions: @ExpressiveLauncherFeedback

text:
Thanks for the log! It was captured during the first setup after a clean flash, and it ends before Gmail ever opens, so it doesn't show the problem yet. Could you:
1. Describe exactly what happens (or send a screenshot): a sign-in loop, "Account action required", sync errors, Gmail not loading mail?
2. Make it happen again, then right away run on your PC:
   adb logcat -b all -d > logcat.txt
   and send that file.
3. Are you rooted (KernelSU, Magisk, SuSFS or other modules)? Your log shows Digital Wellbeing can't see a LineageOS system file, which happens when root hiding hides it.

Your current logs are helpful with another issue I am tracking though. It confirms why Now Playing is not functioning. It confirmed my suspicion on ASI being blocked by PCS. I am deploying a fix for that issue after I can root cause your gmail report.

author: denson9874
text:
Update 2026-10-18: weekly Evolution X sync

New build: EvolutionX-17.0-20261018-cubs-12.3-Unofficial-fastboot.zip
SHA-256 91386eb6c524a88712611a87307652b255ce6d3734e8b25b059471727b7ed929
SourceForge: cubs/17

Already on the 2026-10-16 build? Settings > System > System updates has this one (rooted: Magisk > Install > Install to inactive slot after the update, or root is gone). From an older build: fastboot update <zip> (keeps your data).

Changes (upstream Evolution X, October 9 to 18)

Google apps updated from Pixel 11 Pro firmware CD1A.261005.003.
Android System WebView 155.0.8059.39.
Evolver: the spoofing settings are redesigned in Material 3 Expressive.
Bluetooth no longer turns itself back on by default (auto-on is off).
Mobile network: when a network scan is rejected, the phone falls back to the cells it can see.
Bug reports include the full kernel log.
Translation updates across Evolution X and LineageOS apps.
Known issue: a user has reported that Now Playing won't turn on in this build. It's being looked into.

Unchanged: Espada kernel v3 (Linux 6.12.92) by Kevtrejo37, Extreme Charging, the charging screensaver, "Use device MAC" for Wi-Fi networks that filter by MAC address (since the 10-16 build), and stock CD1A.261005.003 firmware. Reports are very welcome.
